title: ExternalEvidence
description: Third-party intelligence lookup result with explicit provenance and timestamp.

source.description: Provider or feed name (e.g. Google Safe Browsing, VirusTotal).

checked_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the query was executed.

detail.description: Provider-specific category, score, or classification string.

reference_url.description: Link to the external provider's report page.

note.description: Mandatory disclaimer note (e.g., stating not_flagged is not proof of safety).
